title: A hand-written record fills one slot
statement: Each technical record of STEGO that no tooling record generates and nothing provides MUST fill exactly one slot of this pattern.

title: A fill serves an essential record
statement: Each fill MUST implement, build or sit under an essential record; code that serves no essential record MUST be removed.

title: A fill follows the code standard
statement: Each fill MUST meet every rule of ST-STD-CODE that applies to its kind.
